paite: Huan TOUPA thu Jonah kiang ah ahong tung nawn leuleu a,
heading: Jonah Sawl Nawnna Leh Mite Kisikna

paite: "Thou inla, Nineveh khua, khopi thupitak ah hoh inla, thu gen ding ka hon chih pen va tangkoupih in," chi in.
Huchi in Jonah athou a, TOUPA thu bang in Nineveh ah ahohta hi. Nineveh bel khopi thupi petmah, ni thum pai aching hi.
Jonah ni khat pai zoh chiang khopi sung ah ava pai phot a, "Ni sawmli in, Nineveh hihman ahi ding hi," chi in akikou hi.
Nineveh mite'n Pathian agingta ua; an ngawl apuang ua, alak ua alianpen a kipan aneupen tan in sai-ip puan asilh uhi.
Huai thu Nineveh kumpipa bil ahong tungta a, alaltutphah a kipan athou a, akumpi puan asuah a, sai-ip puan silh in, vut ah atuta hi.

Kumpipa leh amiliante thupiak in kumpipa'n Nineveh khosung ah thu apuang in apulakta hi. "Mihing hiam, ganta hiam, ganhon hiam, belamhon hiamte in bangmah chiam kei uhen; banghiam ne in tui leng dawn kei uhen;
mihing leh ganhingte'n sai-ip puan silh uhenla, nakpitak in Pathian sam uhen; ahi, michih in amau lampi hoih lou leh akhut ua hiamgamna lehngatsan uhen.
I manlouhna ding in, Pathian lunghei in lungsim kilehhei in, ahehna mahmah a kipan akilehhei kei ding chih kua'n ahia theithei?" achi hi.
Huchi in Pathian in athilhihte uh en in, alampi hoih lou uh alehngatsan uh chih amu a; akiang ua achihsa, hih atup thil hoih lou Pathian in alehngatsan a; ahihta kei hi.
